header.title: Rental property
header.subtitle: The cash flow and the P&L of a rental flat, the commitment of its tax-incentive scheme, the figures of the rental-income return and the renegotiate-or-sell indicators. Everything is computed from its bank account, its loan schedule and the facts you recorded: a missing fact is listed, never guessed.
header.unlinked: {{n}} account(s) are flagged "rental" but belong to no property: set account on a property (Edit facts).

empty.title: No rental property yet
empty.body: A rental property is an asset of kind real_estate_rental. Give it its bank account (purpose "rental"), its loan and, for a tax-incentive scheme, the commitment you signed.

cashflow.emptyTitle: No closed month of data for this property yet
cashflow.empty: Link its bank account (Edit facts, field "account"), or tag the payments made from another account with {{tag}}.
cashflow.title: Last twelve closed months
cashflow.subtitle: A cash flow: the loan principal counts as money out. The effort d'épargne is what you had to add each month when the rent did not cover the costs.
cashflow.flowsToLabel: {{n}} flow(s) of the property account are in no property category and sit in "other flows". Label them with a memory annotation (rent, loan, charges, tax, fees, insurance, works), or tag a cost paid from another account {{tag}}.

links.title: Property {{id}}
links.hint: Link the account and the loan to get the full cash flow, the interest of the return and the net equity.

table.partialTitle: the account data do not cover the whole month
table.partialNote: * the bank data do not cover the whole month: its figures are lighter in the chart and not averaged.

vacancy.title: Vacancy
vacancy.subtitle: A month without the expected rent, once the property is let. Months the data do not cover are never counted.
vacancy.none: No month without rent since the property was let ({{n}} month(s) followed).
vacancy.late: the rent of {{month}} has not arrived yet

pnl.title: P&L {{year}}
pnl.monthsIncomplete: {{n}} closed month(s): not a complete year
pnl.effortWithAverage: Effort d'épargne: <total/> (about <average/> a month). Your own transfers into the account (<owner/>) are not rent.
pnl.effort: Effort d'épargne: <total/>. Your own transfers into the account (<owner/>) are not rent.
pnl.loanSplit: Loan of the year from its schedule: interest <interest/>, borrower insurance <insurance/>, principal <principal/>.
pnl.economic: Result if the principal repaid is not a cost: <result/>.
pnl.grossYield: Gross yield on the value you declared: {{pct}} %.
pnl.notCovered: Not fully covered by the account data: {{months}}.

scheme.emptyTitle: No scheme recorded for this property
scheme.empty: Give the scheme's name, the start of the commitment and its length in years (6, 9 or 12 for a Pinel-type scheme); the end date and its reminders follow. The rent cap and the tenant income limit are the figures you read in your deed: nothing is looked up.
scheme.title: {{scheme}}: commitment
scheme.subtitle: The end date counts the commitment from its start date; check it against your deed.

rentCap.title: Rent cap
rentCap.subtitle: Your own figures: the cap you declared against the rent
rentCap.notChecked: Not checked: record a rent cap and the lease rent.

tenantIncome.title: Tenant income
tenantIncome.subtitle: The limit and the income you declared
tenantIncome.notChecked: Not checked: record the income limit and the tenant's reference income.

missingFacts.title: Facts the coach does not know
missingFacts.subtitle: Never guessed: record them, or let the coach ask you (Memory > Questions).

schemeBody.reminders: Reminders while no decision is recorded: {{list}}. They go through the alerts (kind "Rental scheme commitment ending"); an external message only says that an alert exists.

extension.title: Decision at the end of the commitment
extension.description: Recorded in the memory (with its history); the reminders stop once a decision is recorded.
extension.rate: Extra reduction rate of the extension (%)
extension.rateHint: as the scheme states it, optional

vacancyDialog.title: Declare a vacancy
vacancyDialog.description: A period you know the property was not let (works, between two tenants). The months it covers are not reported as a missing rent.

tax.declaredNextSpring: The income year is declared the spring after it.
tax.candidates: Candidates for the rental-income return, computed from the bank flows: not a return, nothing is filed, not tax advice.
tax.notCovered: The year is not fully covered by the property account{{details}}: the figures are a lower bound for the rents and for the costs.

micro.title: Micro-foncier
micro.subtitle: Flat abatement of {{pct}} % on the gross rents
micro.overCeiling: The household's gross rents (<rents/>) exceed the ceiling (<ceiling/>): this regime would not apply.

reel.title: Real regime
reel.subtitle: Gross rents less the costs the return lets you deduct

lower.title: Which is lower?
lower.subtitle: The lower taxable figure between the two candidates; the choice of a regime has consequences over several years: check with the tax office or an adviser.
lower.text: The {{regime}} gives the lower taxable figure ({{reel}} against {{micro}}; difference ).

reduction.title: Scheme reduction (candidate)
reduction.subtitle: Computed from the price and the total rate you declared; a tax reduction, not a deduction from the rental income
reduction.forYearOutside: For {{year}}: (the year is outside the commitment).

market.title: Market rate
market.subtitle: A rate you looked up for a loan of similar duration (your own quote, a comparator). The coach never looks it up.

commitmentEnd.title: End of the commitment
commitmentEnd.recordStart: record the start and the length

equity.title: Net equity
equity.subtitle: Declared value − capital still due, before selling costs, penalty and tax
equity.hint: value {{value}} − capital due {{due}} ({{pct}} % of the value)

renegotiation.title: Renegotiation on the real schedule
renegotiation.subtitle: An estimate with the fees you gave (none by default): your bank or a broker gives the binding figures

indicators.title: Indicators
indicators.subtitle: Trailing effort d'épargne: {{amount}} a month
indicators.none: No indicator yet: record the loan, the valuation, the commitment and a market rate.

marketDialog.title: Remember this market rate
marketDialog.description: Written to the property in the memory with its date; after 30 days it is flagged as possibly outdated.
marketDialog.sourcePlaceholder: a quote, a comparator, a date

facts.title: Facts of the property
facts.description: Only what you change is written (blank fields are left as they are). These are YOUR figures from the deed and the scheme's table: the coach never looks them up.

field.rentCapM2: Rent cap per m² (EUR a month)
field.reductionRate: Total reduction rate over the commitment (%)
field.reductionFirstYear: First tax year of the reduction

hint.account: its purpose should be rental (Household page)
hint.loan: the loan file that financed it
hint.scheme: e.g. the name on your deed: free text
hint.rentCapM2: as you computed it from the scheme's table
hint.rentCapMonthly: wins over the cap per m²
hint.reductionBaseCap: optional, as the scheme states it

declare.title: Declare a rental property
declare.description: An asset of kind real_estate_rental in your memory. Add the scheme and the other facts afterwards (Edit facts).
